titulo: 'Ready to talk': German far right celebrates victory in Saxony-Anhalt
cuerpo: "Everything is possible" was the campaign slogan of the Alternative for Germany (AfD) in Saxony-Anhalt, where the far-right party has won a landslide election victory, although they appear short of a majority in the state parliament. Ulrich Siegmund, who is in pole position to become the state leader, knows he has history in his grasp. We get reaction from CSU MP Tobias Winkler.
